Kdenlive

fullArt & creative

A free video editor with a full timeline, similar to Premiere Pro.

Kdenlive is a multi-track video editor. If you know Premiere Pro, the layout will feel familiar: a project bin, a preview monitor and a timeline. It is more capable than Clipchamp or CapCut, though it has fewer one-click templates.

Why it's here

You used Premiere, Clipchamp and CapCut, and Kdenlive is the best free offline editor for that kind of work on Linux.

What to do next

Kdenlive (app launcher)

What it can do
  • Multi-track video and audio timeline
  • Cuts, trims, transitions and effects
  • Titles and text
  • Colour correction tools
  • Keyframe animation for effects
  • Proxy clips for smooth editing of large footage
  • Automatic subtitles (speech to text) after an extra download
  • Renders to MP4 and many other formats
Getting started
  1. Open Kdenlive from the app launcher.
  2. Set up the project in Project > Project Settings (resolution and frame rate).
  3. Drag your video files into the Project Bin.
  4. Drag clips from the bin onto the timeline.
  5. Cut with the Razor tool or press Shift+R at the playhead.
  6. Add transitions and effects from the Effects and Compositions panels.
  7. Click Render (or Project > Render) and choose MP4 to export.
Everyday tips
  • Save often with Ctrl+S; Kdenlive has crash recovery, but saving is safer.
  • Turn on proxy clips in Project Settings for 4K or phone footage; editing gets much smoother.
  • Lower the preview resolution in the monitor if playback stutters.
  • Keep all your source files in one project folder so links do not break.
  • Use the Undo History (View menu) to go back several steps.
  • Render a short test section before rendering a long video.
Privacy & security
  • Kdenlive works offline; nothing is uploaded.
  • Some features (like speech-to-text models) download extra files the first time; Network protection may ask.
  • As a Flatpak it is sandboxed. Use Flatseal if it cannot see a folder or external drive.
If something goes wrong
  • Playback stutters: use proxy clips and lower preview resolution. Integrated Radeon graphics handle 1080p well, but 4K multi-track editing is heavy.
  • Render is slow: long or 4K videos can take a long time on a laptop. Plug in the charger.
  • Red 'missing clip' warning: a file was moved. Use the dialog to point to its new location.
  • Phone video has variable frame rate and audio drifts: convert it first with HandBrake to a constant frame rate.
  • Crashes during editing: save often and check that your Kdenlive Flatpak is up to date in Discover.

Learn more: https://kdenlive.org  ·  All apps

Blender

fullArt & creative

A free, complete 3D creation suite for modelling, animation and rendering.

Blender does 3D modelling, sculpting, materials, animation, rendering, motion graphics and even video editing. If you know Cinema 4D, Blender covers the same kind of work, but the interface and shortcuts are very different. It is professional software and takes time to learn.

Why it's here

You used Cinema 4D, and Blender is the leading free 3D tool.

What to do next

Blender (app launcher)

What it can do
  • 3D modelling and sculpting
  • Materials and textures
  • Lighting and cameras
  • Keyframe animation and rigging
  • Eevee real-time renderer
  • Cycles realistic renderer
  • Geometry Nodes for procedural effects (similar to MoGraph ideas)
  • Imports and exports FBX, OBJ, glTF and more
  • Huge library of free tutorials online
Getting started
  1. Open Blender and pick General from the splash screen.
  2. Learn to move the view: middle mouse to orbit, Shift + middle mouse to pan, scroll to zoom.
  3. Click the cube, then press G to move, R to rotate and S to scale.
  4. Press Tab to switch between Object Mode and Edit Mode.
  5. Add new objects with Shift+A.
  6. Press F12 to render a picture from the camera.
  7. Save your scene with Ctrl+S (.blend file).
Everyday tips
  • On a touchpad, turn on Edit > Preferences > Input > Emulate 3 Button Mouse (Alt + click to orbit).
  • With no number pad, turn on Emulate Numpad in the same place, or use the view gizmo in the top right.
  • Use Eevee for fast renders on this laptop; Cycles will look more realistic but is slow here.
  • Lower render samples and resolution for test renders.
  • Press F3 to search for any command by name.
  • Follow a beginner course (for example the official Blender Studio or popular 'donut' tutorials) for your version.
Privacy & security
  • Blender works offline.
  • Add-ons and .blend files can contain Python scripts. Only use them from sources you trust.
  • When Blender asks about auto-running scripts in a file, say no unless you trust the file.
  • As a Flatpak it is sandboxed. Use Flatseal if it cannot reach a folder.
If something goes wrong
  • Renders are very slow: this laptop has integrated graphics, so Cycles mostly uses the processor. Use Eevee, fewer samples and smaller sizes.
  • Heavy scenes lag or crash: lower subdivision levels and simplify the scene; 16 GB RAM is shared with the graphics chip.
  • Shortcuts do the wrong thing: make sure the mouse is over the right panel; Blender shortcuts depend on where the pointer is.
  • Cinema 4D files will not open: export from C4D as FBX or OBJ, then import into Blender.

A free AI tool that enlarges and sharpens images, entirely offline.

Upscayl uses AI models to make small or blurry images bigger and cleaner, similar to 'Super Resolution' in Photoshop. It runs on your own computer using the graphics chip (through Vulkan), so nothing is uploaded.

Why it's here

It is a simple, private way to upscale old photos, artwork or screenshots.

What to do next

Upscayl (app launcher)

What it can do
  • Upscale images 2x, 3x or 4x

  • Works fully offline
  • Uses the graphics chip through Vulkan

Getting started
  1. Open Upscayl from the app launcher.
  2. Click to select an image, or drag one into the window.
  3. Choose an AI model from the list.
  4. Choose the output folder.
  5. Click the Upscayl button and wait.
  6. Open the result and compare it to the original.
Everyday tips
  • Try different models; photo models and art models give very different results.
  • Start with small images; very large images take a long time.

  • Clean up any odd AI details afterwards in GIMP or Krita.
Privacy & security
  • Images are processed on your laptop; nothing is uploaded.
  • Network protection may ask if the app tries to connect (for example to check for updates); you can deny it and it still works.

If something goes wrong
  • Very slow: integrated Radeon graphics work, but expect seconds to minutes per image. Big images and 4x scale take longest.
  • Fails or crashes on huge images: try a smaller scale or shrink the image first.
  • Result looks waxy or fake: AI invents detail; try another model or a lower scale.
  • Cannot save to a folder: grant access in Flatseal or choose a folder inside your home folder.

Media & everyday

OBS Studio

fullMedia & everyday

Free software for screen recording and live streaming.

OBS Studio records your screen, webcam and microphone, and can stream live to sites like YouTube or Twitch. You build 'scenes' made of 'sources' (screen, camera, images, text). On this laptop's Wayland desktop, screen capture goes through a system picker where you choose which screen or window to share.

Why it's here

It is the standard free tool for tutorials, gameplay capture, presentations and streaming.

What to do next

OBS Studio (app launcher)

What it can do
  • Record the whole screen or a single window
  • Add webcam, microphone and desktop audio
  • Combine sources into scenes and switch between them
  • Live stream to YouTube, Twitch and others
  • Add text, images and overlays
  • Basic audio filters such as noise suppression
  • Virtual camera for video calls
Getting started
  1. Open OBS Studio. The first time, you can run the Auto-Configuration Wizard (also in the Tools menu).
  2. In the Sources box, click + and choose Screen Capture (PipeWire).
  3. A system picker appears. Choose the screen or window you want and confirm.
  4. Click + again to add Audio Input Capture for your microphone if needed.
  5. Click Start Recording, do your thing, then Stop Recording.
  6. Find your video with File > Show Recordings.
Everyday tips
  • Set where recordings are saved in Settings > Output.
  • MKV is the safest recording format because it survives crashes. Use File > Remux Recordings to turn it into MP4.
  • Watch the audio meters in the Audio Mixer before you start recording.
  • Add a Noise Suppression filter to your microphone (right-click the mic > Filters).
  • Make a separate scene for each layout, such as 'Screen only' and 'Screen + camera'.
  • Do a 10-second test recording before anything important.
Privacy & security
  • On Wayland, OBS cannot secretly record your screen. You always choose what to share in the picker.
  • Close private windows and turn off notifications before recording or streaming.
  • Your stream key is like a password. Never show it on screen or share it.
  • Network protection may ask when OBS first connects to a streaming service. Choose Allow if you use that service.
If something goes wrong
  • Black screen capture: remove the source and add Screen Capture (PipeWire) again, then pick the screen in the picker.
  • No desktop sound: add an Audio Output Capture source and check Settings > Audio.
  • Recording is choppy: lower the output resolution or frame rate in Settings > Video. If a hardware (VAAPI) encoder is listed in Settings > Output, try it.
  • Recording disappeared after a crash: record in MKV, not MP4, so the file can still be opened.

Learn more: https://obsproject.com  ·  All apps

It is the easiest free way to record voice-overs and fix audio for your videos.

What it can do
  • Record from a microphone

LibreOffice

fullliteMedia & everyday

A free office suite for documents, spreadsheets and presentations, similar to Microsoft Office.

LibreOffice includes Writer (like Word), Calc (like Excel), Impress (like PowerPoint), Draw, Base and Math. It opens and saves Microsoft Office files (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx). On the main laptop the full suite is installed; on the older PCs only Writer and Calc are installed.

Why it's here

It handles everyday documents and spreadsheets for free, offline and without an account.

What to do next

LibreOffice Writer, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Impress (app launcher)

What it can do
  • Writer for letters, reports and documents
  • Calc for spreadsheets, formulas and charts
  • Impress for slide presentations (full laptop only)
  • Draw for simple diagrams and PDF edits (full laptop only)
  • Opens and saves Word, Excel and PowerPoint files
  • Exports to PDF with one click
  • Templates and styles
Getting started
  1. Open the app launcher and choose LibreOffice Writer (or Calc).
  2. Type your document as you would in Word.
  3. Use File > Save As and choose the format: .odt (LibreOffice) or Word .docx.
  4. If asked 'Keep current format?', choose Use Word format if you plan to send it to Word users.
  5. Use File > Export as PDF to make a PDF.
  6. Double-click Word or Excel files in Dolphin to open them in LibreOffice.
Everyday tips
  • Prefer a ribbon like Office? Try View > User Interface > Tabbed.
  • To always save in Microsoft formats, look in Tools > Options > Load/Save > General.
  • Use Styles (F11) for headings to keep documents tidy.
  • Ctrl+Shift+V pastes special, such as plain text only.
  • Writer and Calc can also open PDFs for viewing; for editing PDFs, try Draw.
  • Autosave and recovery settings are in Tools > Options > Load/Save > General.
Privacy & security
  • LibreOffice works offline and needs no account.
  • Leave macros disabled for documents from unknown senders; macros can be harmful.
  • Documents may store your name as author. Check File > Properties before sharing.
  • You can password-protect a file with File > Save As > Save with password.
If something goes wrong
  • Layout shifts in Word files: fonts like Calibri may be missing. Similar fonts are used, but complex layouts can move slightly.
  • Spreadsheet macros from Excel do not work: VBA macros are only partly supported.
  • Saved as .odt and the other person cannot open it: save as .docx or .xlsx instead.
  • Impress or Draw is missing on an old PC: only Writer and Calc are installed there, by design.

Joplin

fullMedia & everyday

A free note-taking app that stores notes in Markdown with optional encrypted sync.

Joplin is a notes app like Evernote, OneNote or Obsidian. Notes are written in Markdown (simple text formatting) and organised into notebooks. It can import a folder of Markdown files, such as an Obsidian vault, and can sync between devices with end-to-end encryption.

Why it's here

It keeps notes private and portable, and can bring in existing Markdown or Obsidian notes.

What to do next

Joplin (app launcher)

What it can do
  • Notebooks, sub-notebooks and tags
  • Markdown editor with preview, plus a rich text editor
  • To-do lists with checkboxes
  • Import a folder of Markdown files
  • Attach images and files
  • Optional sync (for example Joplin Cloud, Nextcloud, WebDAV, Dropbox, OneDrive)
  • Optional end-to-end encryption
  • Phone apps for Android and iPhone
  • Plugins for extra features
Getting started
  1. Open Joplin from the app launcher.
  2. Create a notebook with the New notebook button.
  3. Create a note with New note and start typing.
  4. To import an Obsidian vault, use File > Import > MD - Markdown (Directory) and pick the vault folder.
  5. To sync, open Tools > Options > Synchronisation and choose a sync service.
  6. If you sync, turn on encryption in Tools > Options > Encryption and set a strong master password.
Everyday tips
  • Use the toggle button to switch between the Markdown editor and the rich text editor.
  • Use tags for topics that span several notebooks.
  • Ctrl+P (Goto Anything) jumps quickly to a note.
  • Back up regularly with File > Export > JEX.
  • Install the phone app and use the same sync settings to see notes on your phone.
Privacy & security
  • Without sync, notes stay only on this laptop.
  • Turn on end-to-end encryption before syncing to any cloud service.
  • Write down the encryption master password somewhere safe. If you lose it, encrypted notes cannot be recovered.
  • As a Flatpak it is sandboxed. Use Flatseal if it cannot reach the folder you want to import.
If something goes wrong
  • Obsidian [[wiki links]] do not work after import: some Obsidian-only features may not convert. Check a few notes and fix links by hand if needed.
  • Import cannot see your vault folder: give Joplin access to that folder in Flatseal, or copy the vault into your home folder.
  • Sync shows errors: check the sync settings and that Network Monitor did not block Joplin.
  • Notes are encrypted on a new device: enter the same master password there.

qBittorrent

fullMedia & everyday

A clean, ad-free torrent downloader.

qBittorrent downloads files using BitTorrent, a way of sharing files between many computers. It is often used for Linux install images, open-source software and other freely shared files. It has no ads or bundled extras, unlike some Windows torrent apps.

Why it's here

It is the safest, simplest torrent app for legal downloads such as Linux ISOs.

What to do next

qBittorrent (app launcher)

What it can do
  • Open .torrent files and magnet links
  • Pause, resume and prioritise downloads
  • Choose which files inside a torrent to download
  • Speed limits and scheduling
  • Bind to a VPN network interface
  • Built-in RSS feeds
  • Optional search plugins
Getting started
  1. Connect your VPN first.
  2. Open qBittorrent from the app launcher.
  3. Use File > Add Torrent Link to paste a magnet link, or File > Add Torrent File.
  4. Choose where to save the files and click OK.
  5. Watch progress in the main list.
  6. When finished, right-click the torrent to open its folder.
Everyday tips
  • Look in Tools > Options > Advanced for the network interface setting, and choose your VPN so downloads stop if the VPN drops.
  • Set upload and download limits in Tools > Options > Speed.
  • Seeding (sharing back) for a while is good manners.
  • Check downloaded files with your antivirus or common sense before opening them.
  • Remove finished torrents from the list when you no longer want to share them.
Privacy & security
  • Without a VPN, other people in the torrent can see your home IP address.
  • Only download content you have the right to download. Sharing copyrighted films, music or software is illegal in many countries.
  • Network protection may ask before qBittorrent connects; it needs the internet to work. Choose Allow.
  • Do not run programs downloaded from torrents unless you trust the source.
If something goes wrong
  • Downloads stuck at 0%: the torrent may have no seeders, or the VPN or Network protection is blocking it (secure-linux-netguard pause 15 shows whether it is Network protection).
  • Cannot save to a drive: grant folder access in Flatseal.
  • Slow speeds: check your speed limits in Options and how many people are sharing.
  • Downloads stopped after the VPN dropped: that is the safety setting working. Reconnect the VPN.

Learn more: https://www.qbittorrent.org  ·  All apps

Parabolic + yt-dlp

fullMedia & everyday

Download video or audio from websites, with a simple window (Parabolic) or a command line tool (yt-dlp).

yt-dlp is a powerful command line tool that downloads video and audio from many websites. Parabolic is a friendly window app built on top of it, so you can paste a link and click download. Both are installed: Parabolic as a Flatpak, and yt-dlp as a system command.

Why it's here

It is handy for saving your own videos, Creative Commons content or clips you have permission to use in edits.

What to do next

Parabolic (app launcher); yt-dlp in Konsole

What it can do
  • Download video from many websites
  • Download audio only (for example MP3)
  • Choose quality and format
  • Download subtitles where available
  • Download playlists
  • Queue several downloads
Getting started
  1. Copy the link of the video from your browser.
  2. Open Parabolic from the app launcher.
  3. Click the button to add a download and paste the link.
  4. Choose video or audio and the quality.
  5. Choose the save folder and start the download.
  6. Command line instead: open Konsole and type yt-dlp followed by the link.
Everyday tips
  • Audio only with yt-dlp: yt-dlp -x --audio-format mp3 LINK
  • List available formats: yt-dlp -F LINK
  • Put the link in quotes if it contains & characters.
  • Files from yt-dlp are saved in the folder Konsole is in (usually your home folder).
  • Websites change often; keep the system updated so yt-dlp keeps working (sudo dnf upgrade).
Privacy & security
  • Respect copyright and each website's terms of service. Only download what you own or have permission to use.
  • Avoid signing into accounts or passing browser cookies to these tools unless you understand the risk.
  • Network protection may ask when Parabolic or yt-dlp first connects to the internet.
  • As a Flatpak, Parabolic may need Flatseal to save into folders outside your home folder.
If something goes wrong
  • Download suddenly fails: the website changed. Update with sudo dnf upgrade and try again later.
  • yt-dlp -U says it cannot update: it was installed by the system, so update it with dnf instead.
  • Separate video and audio files appear: let the tool finish merging; a failed merge usually means a format problem, so try another quality.
  • Command not working because of the link: wrap the link in quotes.

Learn more: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp  ·  All apps

Easy Effects

fullMedia & everyday

Adds sound effects to your speakers and microphone, like a system-wide equaliser and noise remover.

Easy Effects applies audio effects to everything the laptop plays, and to your microphone. You can use an equaliser to make thin laptop speakers sound fuller, and noise reduction to clean up your mic for calls and recordings. It works like the audio 'enhancements' some Windows laptops have, but with much more control.

Why it's here

Laptop speakers sound better with a preset, and noise reduction makes voice recordings and calls cleaner.

What to do next

Easy Effects (app launcher)

What it can do
  • System-wide equaliser for speakers and headphones
  • Load and save presets
  • Microphone noise reduction
  • Compressor and limiter to even out volume
  • Bass enhancer and other effects
  • Separate settings for output (speakers) and input (microphone)
Getting started
  1. Open Easy Effects from the app launcher.
  2. Look at the Output tab (speakers) and the Input tab (microphone).
  3. On the Output tab, add an Equalizer effect, or load a preset from the Presets menu.
  4. On the Input tab, add a Noise Reduction effect for your microphone.
  5. Play some music and switch the effects on and off to hear the difference.
  6. Save your settings as a preset so you can load them again.
Everyday tips
  • Effects only work while Easy Effects is running. Look in its preferences for an option to start it at login.
  • Community preset packs for laptop speakers are available online; import them through the Presets menu.
  • Keep the volume reasonable after adding bass boosts so small speakers do not distort.
  • Make separate presets for speakers and headphones.
  • If you use noise reduction here, you usually do not need it again in OBS or Audacity.
Privacy & security
  • Easy Effects processes sound locally; nothing is sent online.
  • Only import presets from sources you trust; they are just settings files.
  • Apps need microphone permission separately; Easy Effects does not share your mic with anyone.
If something goes wrong
  • No change in sound: make sure Easy Effects is running and the effects are switched on.
  • Sound is distorted or too quiet: lower the equaliser gains or add a limiter.
  • Microphone sounds robotic: reduce the noise reduction strength.
  • Echo or delay in calls: some effects add delay; turn off heavy effects for live calls.

Learn more: https://github.com/wwmm/easyeffects  ·  All apps
